ref_extractions.title: Electromechanical and robot-assisted arm training for improving activities of daily living, arm function, and arm muscle strength after stroke (Review)
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This is a Cochrane systematic review/meta-analysis of multiple randomized controlled trials on robot-assisted arm training for stroke. It does not reference or use any specific EEG dataset, let alone openneuro_ds007180. The review synthesizes evidence across many studies without analyzing raw EEG data.

ref_extractions.title: An EEG database for the cognitive assessment of motor imagery during walking with a lower-limb exoskeleton
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This paper presents a new EEG dataset collected during the DECODED subproject under EUROBENCH using a H3 exoskeleton. While it involves EEG and exoskeletons, it describes the authors' own data collection rather than referencing or using openneuro_ds007180. The dataset described here is distinct from openneuro_ds007180.

ref_extractions.title: A large electroencephalographic motor imagery dataset for electroencephalographic brain computer interfaces
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This paper describes a large EEG BCI dataset (60 hours, 13 participants) collected during motor imagery tasks. Participants sat in a recliner chair performing mental imagery while viewing a computer screen. No exoskeleton or gait task was involved. This paradigm is fundamentally different from the openneuro_ds007180 exoskeleton gait study.

ref_extractions.title: Noninvasive Electroencephalogram Based Control of a Robotic Arm for Reach and Grasp Tasks
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This paper describes an EEG-based BCI system for controlling a robotic arm to perform reach and grasp tasks. The study involved healthy subjects learning to control a robotic arm through motor imagery. There is no mention of openneuro_ds007180 or any exoskeleton gait paradigm.

ref_extractions.title: EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs): A Survey of Recent Studies on Signal Sensing Technologies and Computational Intelligence Approaches and Their Applications
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This is a broad survey/review paper covering EEG-based BCI technologies across multiple application areas. It does not present original data analysis or reference any specific EEG dataset including openneuro_ds007180.

ref_extractions.title: Effect of Lower Limb Exoskeleton on the Modulation of Neural Activity and Gait Classification
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This paper investigates EEG and EMG activity during walking with an exoskeleton (EKSO) in three assistance modes. However, the study was conducted by the PRO GAIT Consortium with 10 healthy volunteers using an EKSO exoskeleton. This is a separate study/data collection from openneuro_ds007180 and no reference to that dataset is made.

ref_extractions.title: Control strategies for active lower extremity prosthetics and orthotics: a review
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This is a review article summarizing control strategies for lower limb prosthetics and orthotics. It does not present original EEG data analysis or reference any specific dataset including openneuro_ds007180.

ref_extractions.title: Brain-computer interface robotics for hand rehabilitation after stroke: a systematic review
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This is a systematic review of BCI-robot systems for hand rehabilitation after stroke. It synthesizes evidence from 30 studies but does not analyze any specific EEG dataset or reference openneuro_ds007180.

ref_extractions.title: Upper limb movements can be decoded from the time-domain of low-frequency EEG
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This paper describes EEG-based decoding of upper limb movements (executed and imagined) using an exoskeleton with anti-gravity support (Hocoma). The study focuses on sustained upper limb movements and does not involve gait or reference openneuro_ds007180.

ref_extractions.title: EEG-Based BCI Control Schemes for Lower-Limb Assistive-Robots
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This is a review paper summarizing EEG-based BCI control schemes for lower-limb assistive robots including exoskeletons. It discusses general frameworks and paradigms but does not reference or use any specific EEG dataset including openneuro_ds007180.

ref_extractions.title: Design and Optimization of an EEG-Based Brain Machine Interface (BMI) to an Upper-Limb Exoskeleton for Stroke Survivors
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This paper describes EEG-based BMI control of an upper-limb exoskeleton (MAHI Exo-II) for stroke survivors. While it involves EEG and exoskeletons, it concerns upper-limb (not lower-limb) rehabilitation and does not reference openneuro_ds007180.

ref_extractions.title: Progress in Brain Computer Interface: Challenges and Opportunities
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This is a comprehensive review paper summarizing progress in BCI research over decades. It discusses various BCI paradigms, applications, and challenges but does not present original data analysis or reference any specific EEG dataset including openneuro_ds007180.

ref_extractions.title: Brain-Computer Interface Spellers: A Review
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This is a review article summarizing BCI speller systems based on P300, SSVEP, and motor imagery paradigms. It does not present original data analysis or reference any specific EEG dataset including openneuro_ds007180.

ref_extractions.title: Experimental Protocol to Assess Neuromuscular Plasticity Induced by an Exoskeleton Training Session
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This paper describes a study protocol for the PRO GAIT project involving exoskeleton gait training with EEG/EMG recordings. It is a protocol paper describing planned methodology but does not present results or reference openneuro_ds007180.

ref_extractions.title: A Review on Design of Upper Limb Exoskeletons
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This is a review paper focusing on mechanical design and mechatronic aspects of upper limb exoskeletons. It does not present EEG data analysis or reference any specific EEG dataset including openneuro_ds007180.

ref_extractions.title: A Review of Classification Techniques of EMG Signals during Isotonic and Isometric Contractions
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This is a review paper about EMG signal classification techniques for isotonic and isometric contractions. It does not involve EEG, exoskeleton gait, or any specific EEG dataset including openneuro_ds007180.

ref_extractions.title: EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces Using Motor-Imagery: Techniques and Challenges
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This is a review paper summarizing signal processing techniques for motor imagery EEG-based BCIs. While it discusses EEG and motor imagery, it does not present original data analysis or reference any specific EEG dataset including openneuro_ds007180.

ref_extractions.title: Corticomuscular coherence during upright standing in unilateral transfemoral amputees
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This paper investigates corticomuscular coherence between motor cortex and muscles during quiet standing in transfemoral amputees. The paradigm involves static balance tasks, not exoskeleton-assisted gait. It does not reference openneuro_ds007180.

feasibility_reason: The dataset is a well-known OpenNeuro public EEG dataset with a clearly defined paradigm (exoskeleton-assisted upper limb movement) and a rich event structure of 30 stimulus condition categories. The analysis.md provides a concrete 8-class upper limb movement classification task with epoching parameters and label definitions, despite all reference papers being classified as irrelevant.
tasks_section:
## Tasks

### Potential Task 1: Upper Limb Movement Classification
- **Task Type**: classification
- **Epoch Method**: `epoch_by_event_hdf5`
- **Epoch Parameters**: tmin = -0.4 s, tmax = 0.4 s, target_events = [`S13`, `S23`, `S33`, `S43`, `S53`, `S63`, `S73`, `S83`]
- **Label Route**: `event`
- **Meta Level**: raw
- **Target Definition**:
  | Event | y | Meaning |
  |-------|---|---------|
  | `S13` | 0 | Upper limb: elbow flexion |
  | `S23` | 1 | Upper limb: elbow extension |
  | `S33` | 2 | Upper limb: forearm supination |
  | `S43` | 3 | Upper limb: forearm pronation |
  | `S53` | 4 | Upper limb: hand close |
  | `S63` | 5 | Upper limb: hand open |
  | `S73` | 6 | Rest condition |
  | `S83` | 7 | Movement imagination |
- **Evidence**: DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0182578 (supports upper limb MI/executed movement classification with exoskeleton support)
- **Kernel Notes**: Filter EEG to 0.3–3 Hz passband per source paper. Maintain versioned trigger decoding table mapping Sx3 codes to movement labels.

### Potential Task 2: Exoskeleton Assistance Mode Classification
- **Task Type**: classification
- **Epoch Method**: `epoch_by_event_hdf5`
- **Epoch Parameters**: tmin = -0.2 s, tmax = 1.0 s, target_events = [`S21`, `S22`, `S31`, `S32`, `S41`, `S42`, `S51`, `S52`, `S61`, `S62`, `S71`, `S72`, `S81`, `S82`]
- **Label Route**: `event`
- **Meta Level**: raw
- **Target Definition**:
  | Event | y | Meaning |
  |-------|---|---------|
  | `S21` | 0 | Mode S2 × assistance level 1 |
  | `S22` | 1 | Mode S2 × assistance level 2 |
  | `S31` | 2 | Mode S3 × assistance level 1 |
  | `S32` | 3 | Mode S3 × assistance level 2 |
  | `S41` | 4 | Mode S4 × assistance level 1 |
  | `S42` | 5 | Mode S4 × assistance level 2 |
  | `S51` | 6 | Mode S5 × assistance level 1 |
  | `S52` | 7 | Mode S5 × assistance level 2 |
  | `S61` | 8 | Mode S6 × assistance level 1 |
  | `S62` | 9 | Mode S6 × assistance level 2 |
  | `S71` | 10 | Mode S7 × assistance level 1 |
  | `S72` | 11 | Mode S7 × assistance level 2 |
  | `S81` | 12 | Mode S8 × assistance level 1 |
  | `S82` | 13 | Mode S8 × assistance level 2 |
- **Evidence**: DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0182578 (exoskeleton interaction paradigm with assistance level variations)
- **Kernel Notes**: Sx1/Sx2 pairs (~1860–1885 counts each) represent paired assistance conditions. Extended epoch window [-0.2, 1.0]s captures pre-movement baseline and sustained assistance-related cortical activity.

### Potential Task 3: Lower Limb Movement Classification
- **Task Type**: classification
- **Epoch Method**: `epoch_by_event_hdf5`
- **Epoch Parameters**: tmin = -0.4 s, tmax = 0.4 s, target_events = [`S93`, `S103`, `S113`, `S123`]
- **Label Route**: `event`
- **Meta Level**: raw
- **Target Definition**:
  | Event | y | Meaning |
  |-------|---|---------|
  | `S93` | 0 | Lower limb movement type 9 |
  | `S103` | 1 | Lower limb movement type 10 |
  | `S113` | 2 | Lower limb movement type 11 |
  | `S123` | 3 | Lower limb movement type 12 |
- **Evidence**: Plausible from paradigm structure; S9x–S12x series likely encode distinct lower limb movement variants (1250 counts each) analogous to Sx3 pattern from upper limb tasks
- **Kernel Notes**: Sx6 variants (~100–135 counts) likely encode movement phase/offset markers; exclude from primary classification unless phase-locked analysis required.

### Normal Task 4: Gait Phase Marker Analysis
- **Task Type**: classification
- **Epoch Method**: `epoch_by_event_hdf5`
- **Epoch Parameters**: tmin = -0.1 s, tmax = 0.3 s, target_events = [`S16`, `S26`, `S36`, `S46`, `S56`, `S66`, `S76`, `S86`]
- **Label Route**: `event`
- **Meta Level**: raw
- **Target Definition**:
  | Event | y | Meaning |
  |-------|---|---------|
  | `S16` | 0 | Gait phase marker for movement type 1 |
  | `S26` | 1 | Gait phase marker for movement type 2 |
  | `S36` | 2 | Gait phase marker for movement type 3 |
  | `S46` | 3 | Gait phase marker for movement type 4 |
  | `S56` | 4 | Gait phase marker for movement type 5 |
  | `S66` | 5 | Gait phase marker for movement type 6 |
  | `S76` | 6 | Gait phase marker for movement type 7 |
  | `S86` | 7 | Gait phase marker for movement type 8 |
- **Evidence**: Intermediate support; Sx6 events (~97–135 counts each) exhibit lower counts consistent with phase markers rather than trial conditions
- **Kernel Notes**: Shorter epoch window [-0.1, 0.3]s appropriate for brief phase-locked responses. May be combined with movement events for gait event-related analysis.


### Normal Task 5: Experimental Block/Phase Classification
- **Task Type**: classification
- **Epoch Method**: `epoch_by_event_hdf5`
- **Epoch Parameters**: tmin = -0.5 s, tmax = 0.5 s, target_events = [`S91`, `S92`, `S101`, `S102`, `S111`, `S112`, `S121`, `S122`]
- **Label Route**: `event`
- **Meta Level**: raw
- **Target Definition**:
  | Event | y | Meaning |
  |-------|---|---------|
  | `S91` | 0 | Block S9 × condition 1 |
  | `S92` | 1 | Block S9 × condition 2 |
  | `S101` | 2 | Block S10 × condition 1 |
  | `S102` | 3 | Block S10 × condition 2 |
  | `S111` | 4 | Block S11 × condition 1 |
  | `S112` | 5 | Block S11 × condition 2 |
  | `S121` | 6 | Block S12 × condition 1 |
  | `S122` | 7 | Block S12 × condition 2 |
- **Evidence**: Intermediate support; S9x–S12x series represent higher-order block structure (~1250–1294 counts) distinct from S1x–S8x movement series
- **Kernel Notes**: Counts suggest distinct experimental phases or blocks. May indicate different exoskeleton configurations or task sequences. S255 (75 counts) probable experiment end marker; exclude from classification tasks.
